name: kmc
description: Krista Mashore Coaching - preparation tools for students installing their Authority Operating System.

plugins.name: boss-pre-setup
plugins.description: STEP ONE OF TWO. Gets this computer ready before your operating system is installed - sets up what your Claude is allowed to do, puts the tools it needs in place, and signs you in. It does NOT install your operating system itself; it hands off to that at the end. Run this first, then the setup it starts does the rest.
